meta.name: generate-release-notes
meta.description: Generate release notes for this project in a consistent format from merged commits/PRs. Use when the user asks for release notes, a changelog entry, or "what changed in this release".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把合并提交自动整理成规范发布说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在每次发版时快速生成给团队看的变更清单。
copy.tagline_en: Turn merged commits into consistent release notes automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to communicate what changed each release without manual effort.

howto.what: Claude 会读取最近一次版本标签之后的提交记录，将 Conventional Commits 按类型归组，把每条重写成面向用户的简明描述，并输出固定格式的发布说明（含版本号和日期）。合并提交和版本号 bump 会被剔除。
howto.when: 当你要求写发布说明、更新日志，或问“这个版本改了什么”时触发。

say.text: 生成最近的发布说明，按模板输出
say.note: Claude 会去找上次发布后的提交并整理成文档。

say.text: 根据合并的 PR 写一条 changelog 条目
say.note: 会要求提供或查找提交记录，输出分组条目。
Claude 会列出主要的用户可见改动。

howto.what_en: Claude reads commits since the last version tag, groups Conventional Commits by type, rewrites each as a concise user-facing line, and outputs release notes in a fixed template with version and date. Merge commits and release bumps are dropped.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for release notes, a changelog entry, or "what changed in this release".

say_en.text: Generate release notes for the recent version
say_en.note: Claude will gather commits since the last tag and format them.

say_en.text: Write a changelog entry from merged PRs
say_en.note: It will look up commits and group them by type.
Claude will list the main user-facing updates.
